verdict.rationale: Mintlify's content model appears portable. Docs are edited via Git and the agent opens PRs in your own docs repo, configuration lives in a plain `docs.json` file, every page has a Markdown version (`.md` suffix, plus llms-full.txt), and the REST API can export analytics data. However, the evidence never describes a documented all-data export or offboarding path, so leaving cleanly is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: explicit full-account data export / offboarding documentation, export of assistant conversations, search and feedback data, and independent hands-on confirmation of migrating away.
